# Code Generated by Sidekick is for learning and experimentation purposes only.
import os
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, Header
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

@router.post("/register", status_code=201)
def register(
    payload: RegisterIn,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    x_admin_secret: str | None = Header(default=None),
):
    email = (payload.email or "").strip().lower()
    if not email or not payload.password:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Email and password required")

    # Default role: customer. Allow admin only with secret.
    role = getattr(payload, "role", None) or "customer"
    if role not in ("admin", "customer"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid role")

    if role == "admin":
        expected = os.getenv("ADMIN_CREATE_SECRET")
        if not expected or x_admin_secret != expected:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Admin creation not allowed")

    # Fast pre-check (still rely on DB unique constraint as the real guard)
    exists = db.query(User).filter(User.email == email).first()
    if exists:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Email already registered")

    user = User(
        email=email,
        password_hash=hash_password(payload.password),
        role=role,
        created_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
    )

    try:
        db.add(user)
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(user)
    except IntegrityError:
        db.rollback()
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Email already registered")

    return {"message": "registered", "id": user.id, "role": user.role}



------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Code Generated by Sidekick is for learning and experimentation purposes only.
async function register(email, password) {
  const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/auth/register`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ email, password })
  });

  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(await res.text());
  return await res.json();
}

    <script>
      // Code Generated by Sidekick is for learning and experimentation purposes only.
      document.getElementById("registerBtn").onclick = async () => {
        const msg = document.getElementById("msg");
        msg.textContent = "";

        const email = document.getElementById("email").value.trim();
        const password = document.getElementById("password").value;
        const confirm = document.getElementById("confirm").value;

        if (!email || !password) return (msg.textContent = "Email and password required.");
        if (password !== confirm) return (msg.textContent = "Passwords do not match.");

        try {
          await register(email, password);
          toast("Account created", "Please sign in.");
          setTimeout(() => (window.location.href = "login.html"), 600);
        } catch (e) {
          msg.textContent = "Registration failed. Email may already exist.";
        }
      };
    </script>
